correctness.rationale: The genus-five complete intersection has a tame (Z/2)^4-cover of P1, yielding a prime-to-23 splitting of p-divisible groups into five elliptic factors. The Hasse polynomial is derived directly as the x^22 coefficient, factored exactly in F23[T], and all 11 simple roots checked in F529. Exhaustive exact root-pair comparison gives s-distribution (56,18,36), and its F23 restriction (18,18,36); S5 pair incidence, simple-root transversality, and total marked counts prove the all-extension formulas. All 420 and 277202 rational parameter pairs were also independently exhaustively enumerated. The 60-point relabeling orbit is checked directly. No finite experiment is presented as an infinite-field proof.

value.rationale: The exact p-rank-one locus of a natural two-dimensional genus-five moduli family consists of 60 marked points in a single geometric branch-equivalence orbit, despite the family admitting five elliptic factors. The 55-component Hasse divisor arrangement has genuine 3-fold and 4-fold intersections (60 each), no 5-fold intersection, and produces all possible positive ranks. The characteristic-23 rational marked family has no ordinary member although ordinary members dominate over F529. These motivated moduli/incidence phenomena are not merely a small isolated point count.
